import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    L = np.log(1+t)
    return (params[0]*P*np.log(P) + params[1]*L**2/P
            + params[2]*np.abs(t)**params[3]*P**params[4]
            + params[5]*L**params[6]*P**params[7])
